description_en: Obtains the lineage information of a deployment
description_zh: 通过本API可以获取作业和数据的血缘信息
name: GetLineageInfo

parameters.help_en: The job ID or the table ID. You can call the ListJobs operation to obtain the job ID or call the ListTables operation to obtain the table ID
parameters.help_zh: 作业实例id或表id。可通过listjobs接口获取作业实例ID或通过lisTables接口获取表ID
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en: The depth of the data lineage
parameters.name: depth

parameters.help_en: The data type of the job or table. If the id parameter is set to the job ID, the value of this parameter is the data type of the job. If the id parameter is set to the table ID, the value of this parameter is the data type of the table
parameters.help_zh: 数据类型，JOB/TABLE，需要和id设置一致
parameters.name: id_type

parameters.help_en: The lineage type. The value true indicates a field-level lineage. The value false indicates a table-level lineage
parameters.help_zh: 谱系类型，true为字段级血缘，false为表级血缘
parameters.name: is_column_level

parameters.help_en:
The direction of the lineage. Valid values:

*   UPSTREAM: searches for upstream operators.
*   DOWNSTREAM: searches for downstream operators.
*   BOTH: searches for both upstream and downstream operators
parameters.help_zh:
血缘方向。

- UPSTREAM：寻找上游节点。
- DOWNSTREAM：寻找下游节点。
- BOTH：同时寻找上下游节点
parameters.name: direction

parameters.help_en: Indicates whether the table was a temporary table
parameters.name: is_temporary

v1_body_parameters.help_en: The parameters about the lineage information
v1_body_parameters.name: body
